comment: Really good professor, easy course work and easy exams. Laugh all the time.

Very fair grader even if you aren't super great at using r. Homework isn't checked or graded, your grade consists of 4 projects and 1 interview, but feedback takes awhile to come back. Instructions can be unclear sometimes, I wish there was more accessibility outside class.

Great teacher. Very accessible and helpful outside of class. Her lectures and notes are very clear. If you read the notes and do homework the tests wouldn't be too hard. Not a lot of homework. Would 100/100 recommend.

Rating for DSST289. Dr Orr gives you reading before class (3-4 pages), gives you very little homework. Her teaching is 50/50 but asking questions will work in your favor. Her exam is both take-home(coding) and in class. She really listens to feedback. Her class did not feel heavy at all. Put in your work, A it is.I would take her again for DSST389

In her intro to stats class, her lectures are tough to follow sometimes, but she is super helpful outside of class in office hours. The textbook she used is hit or miss, but at least there's a free version online that she provides. She's very lenient on due dates for homework. I recommend coming in with *some* stats experience for an easier time.
